candidates.requirement: Build this parser with INI_ALLOW_NO_VALUE=1 so a name-only line after a prior parse error can execute the changed guarded handler path.
candidates.target_route: For an accepted input such as "[broken\nname\n", the entry calls ini_parse_string, which delegates through ini_parse_string_length to ini_parse_stream. The unterminated section records an error; the later name-only line requires the guarded handler path.
candidates.failure_condition: The target’s recipe supplies no enabling definition, so ini.h defaults INI_ALLOW_NO_VALUE to 0 and compilation excludes the changed handler guard. No fuzzer input can enable that preprocessor branch.
candidates.alternative_paths: The target has one parse call and no configuration or alias that enables the branch. The default #else path records an error rather than calling the name-only handler; the fixture’s presence in the seed corpus does not change the compiled option.
